Cinematic fantasy concept art, readable silhouette, no visible text, no UI, no watermark.
Personality: The one that hides instead of freezing, wedged so far into the roots the forest seems to be keeping it. Darker, quieter, watching its sibling for the cue to bolt.
Wants: To stay hidden until the danger walks past, and never to be separated from the only family it has.
Fears: Being flushed out of cover, losing sight of its sibling, the cold gap where its mother should be.
Secrets: No forced reveal. Let this entity disclose truth through scene context and player attention.
Body Language: Jams its body into the deepest shadow it can find and watches. Mirrors its sibling exactly: if pup one calms, this one risks a single look.
Sample Dialogue: A low wet trill, almost swallowed by the roots. Silence, then the smallest scrabble of claws deeper into the dark.

Future Hooks: Bring back as an echo if players made a strong choice involving this entity.
